reviewedAreas.result: Only surviving layout-effect owner proceeds after microtask; exact file object/current controller/active checks run before capture use and result publish. Cancel/hide/replacement aborts old owner. Worker dispose is synchronous and idempotent, so immediate replacement can acquire slot; late messages stop at settled. Native capture cancellation discards the wait only; actual bounded OS work keeps its backend admission until it returns.

Viewport allocates at most 100x24 coordinate positions; sparse far cell never allocates preceding dimensions. Clipped merges carry original anchor and full extent; default style fallback uses merge.fromRow/fromColumn. Hidden anchor removes value/runs and detail until explicit show-hidden, and rehiding clears selection. Sheet change uses existing captured version and selected-sheet match; refresh remounts with exact identity/version/hash.

Nullish display selection retains 0/false/empty text independently; detail distinguishes blank display/saved empty text/missing formula cache. Empty/shared formula body maps to null and explicit unavailable-text wording, not reconstructed formula. Rich runs render only when formatted display equals typed text and joined run text; hidden/custom formatted values therefore remain authoritative.

Explicit false font switches emit normal/400/none. Decoration is not placed on ancestor td; each rich run merges base font and run font, allowing explicit off. Table has computed bounded numeric width; grid scroll contains it, cells clip and full detail scrolls. Color allowlist and quoted cleaned font names prevent CSS text injection. Browser workload confirms 32k text does not expand the document horizontally.

ST_Xstring decoded once per original field/run; unknown rich child rejects rather than inventing empty text. Both logical text and repeated rich-run counts are bounded, including empty runs. XML rejects DTD and enforces size/nodes/depth/attributes. Sparse selected-sheet cells/merges/styles are bounded; no formula/URL execution. These are logical limits, not a hard OS heap guarantee.

read_workbook uses capture_expected of the selected VerifiedFile, no extraction. Archive directory preflight precedes ZIP indexing, validates bounded headers/names/overlaps; all entries read with actual decompression caps and CRC, including ignored binary entries. Command requires main webview and existing bounded read-check; fixed structured error codes distinguish unknown read, changed, limit, encrypted, pending and busy. No new file write or Agent permission path.

Search close restores trigger focus; scoped sr-only hides accessible search label visually. Export copy now explicitly limits address redaction to attachment/tool source metadata while body remains original. Static changes do not themselves prove installed search/export acceptance.
